intro: Elixir of Agony is the culmination of Apothecary Lydon's sinister brewing experiments in Tarren Mill. Tasked by the Royal Apothecary Society, Lydon seeks to test a deadly poison disguised as stolen dwarven ale on human prisoners held within the settlement.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Next door the Deathguards are holding a few captured farmers hostage. High Executor Darthalia suspected one of the military strategists from Stormwind to be hiding out amongst them. Apparently the military chap was found dead in the Plaguelands last night. Darthalia, always looking out for me, decided the prisoners would be left to my disposal.
I think it's time we threw those farmers a party. Sounds like a grand ol' time!
Place this tainted keg on the rug in their room. Plagued brew for all!

clips.title: Progress
paras: A musty smell emanates from the rug.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You rest the tainted keg on the dusty rug.
